title: The Last Adventurer
description: In an era when the Gates have appeared and the world has fallen into despair, the Cygnus Knights, Resistance, Cross Hunters, and adventurers have all been defeated. The six legendary heroes who once sealed the Dark Mage are gone, leaving only one adventurer still fighting: Elpam. After reaching the end of his journey, the last adventurer returns to the beginning of the story with a chance to change the fate of Maple World.
author: D-Dart
